name: PayPal (US merchant)
scope: Fees for receiving payments on a US PayPal account. Sending money to friends and family, crypto, Payouts, Hyperwallet, Payflow, and PayPal Point of Sale hardware are out of scope.
structure: Receiving a domestic commercial payment costs a percentage of the amount plus a fixed fee that depends on the currency received ($0.49 for USD; $0.09 for QR-code and micropayment transactions). The percentage depends on how the buyer paid: 3.49% for PayPal Checkout, guest checkout, Pay with Venmo and all other commercial transactions; 2.99% for standard credit and debit card payments; 2.29% for QR code transactions; 2.99% with no fixed fee for money received for goods and services person-to-person; 4.99% for PayPal Pay Later. International transactions add 1.50%. Invoices follow the same percentages, with Pay by Bank (ACH) at 1% capped at $10. Micropayments pricing (by application) is 4.99% + $0.09. Donations are 2.89% + fixed; approved charities 1.99% + fixed. Refunding a payment does not return the fees originally paid. Instant withdrawal to a bank or card costs 1.50% (minimum $0.50).

If you refund a Commercial Transaction or an Invoicing Transaction payment, there are no fees to make the refund, but the fees you originally paid to receive the payment are not returned to you.
excluded: Sending money to friends and family
notes: Fixed fee is per transaction in the currency received; this calculator covers USD only.
PayPal rounds fees at the transaction level; this calculator rounds the computed fee to the cent (half up).

summary: PayPal takes a percentage of each payment you receive plus a fixed $0.49 (or $0.09 for QR and micropayments): 3.49% for PayPal Checkout and most other payments, 2.99% for card payments, 2.29% for QR codes, 4.99% for Pay Later, plus 1.50% when the buyer is outside the US. Refunds don't return the fee.
